project_name: HK Bar POS (蘭桂坊 醉月居 / LKF Midnight Lounge)
persona: E1 Anti-AI Designer - Tactical High-Density HK Speakeasy POS

design_philosophy.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 7 & ARCHETYPE 2 HYBRID (Neon Cyberpunk Meets Tactical Speed)
design_philosophy.vibe: Moody, high-contrast Hong Kong night bar aesthetics with neon red/amber glows, zinc slate surfaces, crisp physical tablet touch zones, and bilingual English + Traditional Chinese typography.
core_principles: Tactical Speed: Large touch targets (min 48px to 64px), persistent right-hand order rail, zero nested modals for common actions.
Hong Kong Speakeasy Vibe: Obsidian black zinc surfaces (#090A0F, #12141D) with Electric Amber (#FF9F0A), Neon Crimson (#FF3B30), Jade Teal (#30D158), and Cyber Yellow (#FFD60A).
Dense Touch-Optimized Bento Grid: Mode B High-Density operational layout with instant visual feedback for table status, prep urgency, and print notifications.
Bilingual Identity: Every key label carries prominent English + Traditional Chinese (e.g. 'Table 04 · 04號檯', 'Fire Course · 催菜', 'Octopus · 八達通').
High Accessibility & Contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast ratio on dark surfaces, tactile 1px slate borders (#2C2F40) to define clear physical touch zones on tablet screens.

headings.usage: Screen titles, Table numbers, Key currency numbers (HK$), Large KPI metrics

body.usage: Order item lists, customer details, KDS prep tickets, inventory lists

mono_data.usage: Receipt totals, Bill #, Ticket timestamps, Print job monitor logs, Staff PIN keypad

tablet_shell.left_sidebar: w-20 md:w-24 bg-[#12141D] border-r border-[#282C3F] flex flex-col justify-between items-center py-4 z-30 shrink-0
tablet_shell.right_ticket_rail: w-80 lg:w-96 bg-[#12141D] border-l border-[#282C3F] flex flex-col z-20 shrink-0

floorplan_grid.container: relative w-full h-full min-h-[500px] bg-[#0A0C12] rounded-xl border border-[#282C3F] overflow-hidden p-6
floorplan_grid.area_switcher: flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#1A1D2B] p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#282C3F] mb-4

register_grid.product_matrix: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 overflow-y-auto p-4 max-h-[calc(100vh-180px)]

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-6 overflow-y-auto

pin_pad.description: Tactile 3x4 numeric keypad for quick staff clock-in / order unlock with employee selector and real-time shift status indicator.

floorplan_map.description: Dual-area floorplan canvas (Main Lounge Bar vs VIP Terrace) with drag-and-drop table positions, guest count pills, order time counter, and status colors.

order_ticket_rail.description: Persistent right-side order sidebar containing table selection, seat selector, order items with modifier tags, course status (Hold/Fire), subtotal, 10% service charge, discount trigger, and giant action buttons for 'Fire Kitchen', 'Print Bill', and 'Pay'.

kds_grid.description: Kitchen/Bar display screen with color-coded ticket urgency (Green < 5m, Amber 5-15m, Red > 15m), coarse item checks, course markers, and one-tap bump actions.

print_monitor.description: Real-time print queue status displaying routed jobs (Bar Drinks Printer, Kitchen Food Printer, Cashier Receipt), status badges (Sent, Printing, Failed), retry buttons, and simulated hardware alerts.

inventory_manager.description: Ingredient & bottle level stock matrix with low stock warnings, wastage logging modal, stock adjustment sliders, and supplier restock trigger.

crm_loyalty.description: Member directory with phone lookup, Tier badges (LKF VIP, Gold, Diamond), reward point redemption, favorite drinks history, and store credit balance.

menu_admin.description: CRUD interface for Categories, Subcategories, Items, Pricing (HK$), Variant Groups (Single/Double/Bottle/Mixer), Tax/Service flags, and Stock link.

payment_modal.description: Split/Merge bill workflow supporting Cash with quick change calculator, HK Octopus Card tap simulation, FPS QR code scanner simulation, and Card Terminal fallback.

reports_analytics.description: Rich charts for Hourly Revenue (peak bar hours 10pm-2am), Category Mix, Payment Method Mix (Octopus vs Cash vs Card), Staff Sales Leaderboard, and Read-Only Cloud Owner Mirror Mode toggle.

hr_clock.description: Staff clock in/out shift log, total hours worked today, hourly rate calculator, and shift report export.

visual_enhancers.status_pill: px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold tracking-wide uppercase

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all React state hooks and API endpoints support instant local response for LAN tablet operation simulation.
Every page or component must feature clear bilingual titles/labels (e.g. 'Register · 點單', 'Floorplan · 檯號圖', 'KDS Prep · 廚房顯示', 'Inventory · 庫存', 'Reports · 報表').
Include mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive controls (buttons, PIN pads, table cards, line items, payment triggers).
Use HK$ currency format everywhere (e.g., HK$ 128.00). Include standard HK 10% Service Charge toggle.
Support offline-first or mock fallback state for print queue retries, Octopus card taps, FPS QR generation, and Cloud Mirror syncing.
Use sonner for instant toast feedback (e.g., 'Ticket Fired to Bar Printer #1', 'Octopus Payment Received HK$248.00', 'Low Stock Alert: Hendricks Gin').
Ensure the design remains strictly Dark Mode with rich zinc slate gradients, neon status badges, and large touch-friendly buttons for tablet operation.
